newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU Commission denies soybean ban rumour.
newsitem.headline: EU Commission denies soybean ban rumour.

text.p: The European Commission has denied rumours circulating among trade organisations that it might impose a ban on genetically modified soybeans.
The rumours began at the United Nations World Food Summit in Rome last week when it was said that European Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler had suggested that scientists would look at the question.

"We understand the concern among traders but that is not what the Commissioner said. He was referring to the issue of genetically modified maize and not soybean which has been accepted," a senior official said.
The secretary general of FEDEOL, the European umbrella group for oilseed traders Pascal Cogels said, "We were naturally concerned. We are now reasssured."
Three EU scientific committees are studying the question of genetically modified maize.
